The function Fr_StartCommunication () shall check whether the CC Fr_CtrlIdx ’s POCState is in POC:ready. If the POCState is not POC:ready, then the function Fr_StartCommunication () shall raise the runtime error FR_E_INV_POCSTATE .

If the function Fr_StartCommunication () is able to and detects a hardware error while performing the requested functionality, then it shall call Dem_SetEventStatus () ( FR_E_CTRL_TESTRESULT , DEM_EVENT_STATUS_FAILED ) and return E_NOT_OK .

The function Fr_StartCommunication () shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx : 1. Invoke the CC CHI command ’RUN’, which initiates the startup procedure within the FlexRay CC. 2. Return E_OK .
